name: Artificer
summary: A master of invention who uses ingenuity and magic to unlock extraordinary capabilities in objects. Artificers are half-casters who infuse their gear with magic and support the party.

hitPoints.Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per artificer level after 1st

proficiencies.Tools: Thieves' tools, tinker's tools, one type of artisan's tools
proficiencies.Skills: Choose two from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception and Sleight of Hand

spellcastingTable.title: The Artificer
rows: Artificer Specialist, The Right Tool for the Job

spellcastingNotes: You prepare artificer spells after each long rest: half your artificer level (rounded down) + your Intelligence modifier, minimum one.

classFeatures.name: Magical Tinkering
keyFacts: Light, sound, smell, message or image on a Tiny object.
Up to INT modifier objects at once.
classFeatures.summary: With thieves' or artisan's tools in hand, you can touch a Tiny nonmagical object and give it a small magical property: it sheds light, plays a recorded message, emits a sound or smell, or shows a picture. You can keep a number of such objects equal to your INT modifier.
classFeatures.short: Give small objects tiny magical effects.

classFeatures.name: Spellcasting
keyFacts: Prepare artificer spells after each long rest: half your artificer level (rounded down) + INT modifier, at least one.
Spell save DC = 8 + PB + INT; spell attack = PB + INT.
classFeatures.summary: You can cast artificer spells. Prepare artificer spells after each long rest: half your artificer level (rounded down) + INT modifier, at least one. INT is your spellcasting ability: spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + INT modifier, spell attack = proficiency bonus + INT modifier. You must have thieves' tools or artisan's tools (or an infused item) in hand as your focus. You regain all spell slots on a long rest.

classFeatures.name: Infuse Item
classFeatures.summary: You learn artificer infusions and can imbue nonmagical items with them after a long rest. You learn 4 infusions at 2nd level (6 at 6th, 8 at 10th, 10 at 14th, 12 at 18th) and can have 2 infused items at once (3 at 6th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 14th, 6 at 18th).
classFeatures.short: Turn mundane items into magic ones.

options.name: Enhanced Arcane Focus
options.summary: A rod, staff or wand gives +1 to spell attacks (+2 at 10th) and ignores half cover.

options.name: Enhanced Defense
options.summary: Armor or a shield gives +1 AC (+2 at 10th).

options.name: Enhanced Weapon
options.summary: A simple or martial weapon gets +1 to attack and damage (+2 at 10th).

options.name: Homunculus Servant
options.summary: Create a tiny homunculus that fights alongside you and can deliver touch spells.

options.name: Repeating Shot
options.summary: A ranged weapon gets +1 to hit and damage, ignores loading and makes its own ammunition.

options.name: Replicate Magic Item
options.summary: Make a common or uncommon magic item from the artificer list (bag of holding, goggles of night...).

options.name: Returning Weapon
options.summary: A thrown weapon gets +1 to hit and damage and flies back to your hand.

options.name: Boots of the Winding Path
options.summary: Bonus action: teleport back to a space you occupied this turn.

options.name: Radiant Weapon
options.summary: +1 weapon that sheds light and can blind an attacker as a reaction.

options.name: Repulsion Shield
options.summary: +1 shield that can push an attacker 15 ft. away as a reaction.

options.name: Resistant Armor
options.summary: Armor grants resistance to one damage type.

options.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
options.summary: Once per day, regain one spell slot of 3rd level or lower.

options.name: Arcane Propulsion Armor
options.summary: Armor adds 5 ft. speed and turns your gauntlets into force-damage weapons.

options.name: Helm of Awareness
options.summary: Advantage on initiative and you can't be surprised.

options.name: Mind Sharpener
options.summary: Armor or robes help you keep concentration (turn a failed save into a success).

classFeatures.name: Artificer Specialist
classFeatures.summary: Choose your specialty. It grants features at 3rd, 5th, 9th and 15th level.

classFeatures.name: The Right Tool for the Job
keyFacts: Create one set of artisan's tools over 1 hour.
classFeatures.summary: With thieves' or artisan's tools in hand, you can spend 1 hour (or a short rest) to magically create one set of artisan's tools.
classFeatures.short: Conjure any artisan's tools in an hour.

classFeatures.name: Ability Score Improvement
keyFacts: +2 to one ability or +1 to two, or a feat.
classFeatures.summary: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, 19th level, you can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. You can't raise a score above 20 this way. If your DM allows feats, you can take a feat instead.
classFeatures.short: Raise one ability by 2, two by 1, or take a feat.

classFeatures.name: Tool Expertise
keyFacts: Double proficiency bonus on tool checks.
classFeatures.summary: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.

classFeatures.name: Flash of Genius
keyFacts: Uses: INT modifier per long rest.
classFeatures.summary: When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your INT modifier to the roll. Uses equal to your INT modifier (minimum 1) per long rest.
classFeatures.short: Reaction: add your INT to an ally's check or save.

classFeatures.name: Magic Item Adept
keyFacts: Craft common/uncommon items 4× faster for half the gold.
classFeatures.summary: You can attune to up to four magic items at once, and crafting common or uncommon magic items takes you a quarter of the time and half the gold.
classFeatures.short: Attune to 4 items; craft faster and cheaper.

classFeatures.name: Spell-Storing Item
classFeatures.summary: After a long rest, store a 1st- or 2nd-level artificer spell in a weapon or focus. A creature holding it can cast the spell from it a number of times equal to twice your INT modifier.
classFeatures.short: Store a spell in an item for anyone to use.

classFeatures.name: Magic Item Savant
classFeatures.summary: You can attune to up to five magic items at once, and you ignore class, race, spell and level requirements on attuning to or using a magic item.
classFeatures.short: Attune to 5 items, ignore their requirements.

classFeatures.name: Magic Item Master
classFeatures.summary: You can attune to up to six magic items at once.

classFeatures.name: Soul of Artifice
keyFacts: +1 to all saves per attuned item.
End an infusion to stay at 1 HP.
classFeatures.summary: You gain +1 to all saving throws per magic item you are attuned to. If you drop to 0 hit points but don't die, you can end one infusion to drop to 1 hit point instead.
classFeatures.short: +1 to saves per attuned item; cheat death.

journeyStages.summary: Review the artificer at a glance.

journeyStages.label: Class Features
journeyStages.summary: What your class gives you, level by level.

highlights.title: Combat Role
highlights.body: Half-caster support and tinkerer: infuses the party's gear, buffs with spells and fights from medium armor.

highlights.title: Core Resources
highlights.body: Prepared spells (half level + INT) and infusions you swap after each long rest.

highlights.title: Level Rhythm
highlights.body: Spells at 1, infusions at 2, specialist at 3, Tool Expertise at 6, Flash of Genius at 7, Spell-Storing Item at 11.
